content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment entails using a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to sell directly to their audience without third-party interference. By leveraging services like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to the 10% that platforms like Gumroad take, you can significantly increase your earnings. This approach is essential in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or impose excessive fees, making it not just a choice, but a necessity for creators seeking financial autonomy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture consists of several key components: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for product display, a backend logic system through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions, and NOWPayments for secure crypto transactions. When a payment is confirmed, the webhook triggers an automated delivery of the ebook, ensuring that the creator has full control over the sales process. This architecture is designed for efficiency and reliability, allowing creators to focus on their content without worrying about financial logistics.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are locked out of conventional payment systems due to geographical restrictions or high fees. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, or design templates, this stack empowers you to operate independently. Creators in Nigeria, Kenya, Venezuela, and other regions where traditional platforms fail can now successfully manage their digital products and retain full ownership without the burden of ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Control your sales without relying on high-fee platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective functioning of this architecture relies on several components working in harmony. First, the hosting service provides a platform for displaying products. Next, backend scripts handle payment verification and order processing through NOWPayments, which accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies. Lastly, a secure storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. Together, these elements provide a seamless experience from purchase to product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your automated ebook delivery system, first select your hosting platform, like GitHub Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Lastly, ensure that your products are stored securely and are ready for automated delivery. Following these steps will allow you to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of traditional payment gateways.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is possible by using a combination of sovereign tools and automated delivery systems. By integrating a hosting platform with a backend service and a crypto payment processor, you can create an efficient sales funnel that retains maximum profits. This approach eliminates reliance on high-fee platforms.
Automate your ebook delivery and save time on manual processes.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell ebooks without traditional payment platforms by using a sovereign commerce stack that incorporates a hosting service, backend logic for processing, and a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This setup allows you to operate independently.

NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad. This fee structure allows you to retain more profit, especially with higher sales volumes, and it supports over 300 cryptocurrencies for flexibility.

Yes, by using backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth customer experience.
Is there a way to avoid high fees when selling digital products?
Absolutely. By implementing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can bypass high fees associated with platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
What kind of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The infrastructure is designed to support any digital product you create.
